أرتهن (form VIII)
# أَرْتَهِنُ (ʔartahinu) /ʔar.ta.hi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# أُرْتَهَنُ (ʔurtahanu) /ʔur.ta.ha.nu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# أَرْتَهِنَ (ʔartahina) /ʔar.ta.hi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# أُرْتَهَنَ (ʔurtahana) /ʔur.ta.ha
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
